picks.name: DJ One Go
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on WVWV. Guadalajara, Mexico producer -- connects to your Latin American electronic picks (Nicola Cruz, Dengue Dengue Dengue, ZZK/Comeme-adjacent).
picks.bio: "Estacion De Trance" (October 21, 2026, WVWV) is a five-track EP from the Guadalajara producer -- high-energy house and trance cuts, following prior Bandcamp releases like TUNEL DE VIENTO and Cumbia Rave.
picks.why_listen: Driving, trance-inflected house from a Mexican scene connection -- useful peak-energy material with a different regional flavor than most of your current rotation.
